fact: The DARE1 submarine cable, launched in 2021 from Djibouti City to Somalia and Mombasa, is held by a consortium of Djibouti Telecom, Hormuud Telecom Somalia, Somtel International and Telkom Kenya, and is to be extended to South Africa by 2028.
title: Djibouti Telecom to Extend DARE1 Cable From Kenya to S.A
